bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Cyclone and Flood Damage Reinsurance Pool) Bill 2022

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2022-03-30.42.1) introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), which means it failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 26, page 20 (lines 15 to 20), omit section 41, substitute:* > > *41 Review of Act* > > *(1) The Minister must prepare a report that reviews the need:* > >> *(a) to extend the cyclone reinsurance scheme to cover loss or damage caused by any and all natural disasters, including bushfires, storms and hail; and* >> >> *(b) for this Act to continue in operation.* > > *(2) The report must be prepared:* > >> *(a) as soon as practicable after 1 July 2025; and* >> >> *(b) at least once every 5 years after that day.*
